^focus scan on fifteen-centimeter band centered on weld crown particularly section between markings 7.2m and 7.8m from forward nozzle
^if any indication amplitude exceeding 40% DAC pause capture full A-scan data set before proceeding
^do not remove existing insulation layer on vessel exterior
^perform inspection through designated access ports in insulation jacket only

^reduce re-test pressure to 20.3 MPa
^extend hold time to ninety minutes
^if one or more indications above reporting level found do not commence any repair
^close master valve MV-11
^tag vessel with red Hold for Engineering label
^transmit all collected data to central diagnostics server under project ID C18A_Gamma_Assess
^complete inspection report findings by 16:00 today
